questions.question: If the radius of a sphere is doubled, then the volume of the sphere becomes _____ times the previous volume.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of a sphere is proportional to the cube of its radius (V ∝ r³).

Initial radius ratio = 1 : 2

Volume ratio = 1³ : 2³

Volume ratio = 1 : 8

The volume becomes 8 times the previous volume.

**∴ The correct answer is eight.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial radius = r₁

Final radius = r₂ = 2 × r₁

**Formula Used:**

Volume of Sphere (V) = (4/3) × π × r³

 
• r V₁ = (4/3)πr³ 
• r → 2r 
• 2r V₂ = (4/3)π(2r)³ = 8V₁ 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let initial volume be V₁ = (4/3) × π × r₁³

⇒ Let final volume be V₂ = (4/3) × π × r₂³

⇒ Substitute r₂ = 2r₁ in the volume formula:

⇒ V₂ = (4/3) × π × (2r₁)³

⇒ V₂ = (4/3) × π × 8r₁³

⇒ V₂ = 8 × [(4/3) × π × r₁³]

⇒ V₂ = 8 × V₁

**∴ The correct answer is eight.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of Sphere

The total surface area of a sphere is given by A = 4 × π × r². If radius is doubled, the surface area becomes 4 times.

Volume of Hemisphere

The volume of a hemisphere is exactly half of a sphere: V = (2/3) × π × r³.

Hemisphere Surface Areas

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2 × π × r² | Total Surface Area (TSA) = 3 × π × r².

questions.question: The length of the portion of the straight line 5x + 12y = 60 intercepted between the axes is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Equation of a straight line: 5x + 12y = 60

**Concept used:**

The intercept form of a straight-line equation: (x)/(a) + (y)/(b) = 1

Where a and b are x and y intercepts respectively.

**Calculation:**

5x + 12y = 60

Dividing by 60 on both sides,

⇒ (5x)/(60)+(12y)/(60) =(60)/(60)

⇒ (x)/(12)+(y)/(5) =1

Here,

x-intercept = a = 12

y-intercept = b = 5

Now,

The length of the line segment intercepted between the axes is given by the distance between the intercepts:

Length = sqrt{a²+b²}

⇒ Length = sqrt{12²+5²} 

⇒ Length = sqrt{144+25}

⇒ Length = sqrt{169} = 13 cm

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.question: An 8 digit number is divisible by 99. If the digits are shuffled, then the number is always divisible by __________.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

An 8 digit number is divisible by 99. If the digits are shuffled, then the number is always divisible by __________.

**Concept:**

A number is divisible by 99 if and only if it is divisible by both 9 and 11.

Divisibility by 9: A number is divisible by 9 if the sum of its digits is divisible by 9.

Divisibility by 11: A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of the digits in the odd positions and the sum of the digits in the even positions is divisible by 11.

**Calculation:**

Given that the 8-digit number is divisible by 99, it must be divisible by both 9 and 11.

When the digits of a number are shuffled, the sum of its digits remains the same, and so does the difference between the sum of the digits in the odd positions and the sum of the digits in the even positions.

⇒ The sum of the digits remains divisible by 9.

⇒ The difference between the sum of the digits in the odd positions and the sum of the digits in the even positions remains divisible by 11.

Therefore, the number formed by shuffling the digits will also be divisible by both 9 and 11.

**∴ The number is always divisible by 9.**

questions.question: When a number is divided by 512 it leaves a remainder 67. If the same number is divided by 32, then what will be the remainder?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Check if the first divisor is completely divisible by the second divisor.

⇒ 512 ÷ 32 = 16 (completely divisible).

To find the new remainder, simply divide the first remainder by the second divisor.

⇒ 67 ÷ 32 leaves a remainder of 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A number leaves a remainder 67 when divided by 512.

**Formula Used:**

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder

**Calculation:**

Let the number be N and the quotient be q.

⇒ N = 512q + 67

We need to find the remainder when N is divided by 32.

Rewrite the equation in terms of 32:

⇒ N = (32 × 16q) + (32 × 2) + 3

⇒ N = 32(16q + 2) + 3

Let (16q + 2) = k, where k is an integer.

⇒ N = 32k + 3

This shows that when N is divided by 32, the quotient is k and the remainder is 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Division Algorithm

For any given integers a and b (where b > 0), there exist unique integers q and r such that a = bq + r, where 0 ≤ r < b.

Remainder Property in Successive Divisions

If a number leaves a remainder R₁ when divided by D₁, then dividing the same number by D₂ (where D₂ is a factor of D₁) will give the exact same remainder as dividing R₁ by D₂.

questions.question: In an election between two candidates, the defeated candidate secured 42% of the valid votes polled and lost the election by 2545800 votes. If 365500 votes were declared invalid and 30% people did not cast their vote, what was the approximate number of people (in millions) in the electorate who did NOT cast their votes?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The defeated candidate secured 42% of the valid votes polled and lost by 2545800 votes.

365500 votes were declared invalid.

30% of people did not cast their vote.

**Concept:**

To determine the total electorate, we need to calculate the total number of votes and account for the percentage of people who did not vote.

**Formula Used:**

Total Valid Votes = Votes secured by defeated candidate / Percentage secured by defeated candidate

Total Votes Polled = Total Valid Votes + Invalid Votes

Total Electorate = Total Votes Polled / (1 - Percentage of people who did not vote)

People who did not cast their votes = Total Electorate × Percentage of people who did not vote

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the total valid votes be V.

⇒ Defeated candidate secured 42% of valid votes, so:

⇒ V × 42% = 0.42V

⇒ Winning candidate secured (100% - 42%) = 58% of valid votes, so:

⇒ V × 58% = 0.58V

⇒ The difference in votes between the winning and defeated candidate is 2545800:

⇒ 0.58V - 0.42V = 2545800

⇒ 0.16V = 2545800

⇒ V = 2545800 / 0.16

⇒ V = 15911250

⇒ Total Votes Polled = V + Invalid Votes

⇒ Total Votes Polled = 15911250 + 365500

⇒ Total Votes Polled = 16276750

⇒ Total Electorate = Total Votes Polled / (1 - Percentage of people who did not vote)

⇒ Total Electorate = 16276750 / (1 - 0.30)

⇒ Total Electorate = 16276750 / 0.70

⇒ Total Electorate ≈ 23252500

⇒ People who did not cast their votes = Total Electorate × Percentage of people who did not vote

⇒ People who did not cast their votes = 23252500 × 0.30

⇒ People who did not cast their votes ≈ 6975750

**∴ The approximate number of people (in millions) in the electorate who did NOT cast their votes is 7 **million**.**

questions.question: (cot θ + tan θ)(cosec θ − sin θ)(cos θ − sec θ) = ________.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(cot θ + tan θ)(cosec θ − sin θ)(cos θ − sec θ) = ________.

**Concept:**

We need to simplify the trigonometric expression using trigonometric identities.

**Formula Used:**

1. cot θ = 1/tan θ

2. sec θ = 1/cos θ

3. cosec θ = 1/sin θ

**Calculation:**

We start by simplifying each term individually:

⇒ cot θ + tan θ = (cos θ/sin θ) + (sin θ/cos θ)

⇒ = (cos² θ + sin² θ) / (sin θ cos θ)

⇒ = 1 / (sin θ cos θ) [since cos² θ + sin² θ = 1]

Next, simplify cosec θ - sin θ:

⇒ cosec θ - sin θ = (1/sin θ) - sin θ

⇒ = (1 - sin² θ) / sin θ

⇒ = cos² θ / sin θ [since 1 - sin² θ = cos² θ]

Finally, simplify cos θ - sec θ:

⇒ cos θ - sec θ = cos θ - (1/cos θ)

⇒ = (cos² θ - 1) / cos θ

⇒ = -sin² θ / cos θ [since cos² θ - 1 = -sin² θ]

Now, combine all three simplified terms:

⇒ (cot θ + tan θ)(cosec θ - sin θ)(cos θ - sec θ)

⇒ = (1 / (sin θ cos θ)) × (cos² θ / sin θ) × (-sin² θ / cos θ)

⇒ = (1 / (sin θ cos θ)) × (cos² θ / sin θ) × (-sin² θ / cos θ)

⇒ = (-1) [After simplifying the terms and canceling out common factors]

**∴ The expression equals -1.**

questions.question: Monthly expenditure of Ritvik decreases from ₹12,800 to ₹11,712. Find the percentage decrease in his expenditure.

Initial expenditure of Ritvik = ₹12,800

Percentage decrease in expenditure is calculated using the formula:

Percentage Decrease = ((Initial Expenditure - New Expenditure) / Initial Expenditure) × 100

We have,

⇒ Initial Expenditure = ₹12,800

⇒ New Expenditure = ₹11,712

questions.question: A bus driver must complete a 240 km trip in 4 hours. If he averages 70 km an hour for the first 3 hours of his trip. how fast must he travel (in km/h) in the last/final hour?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A bus driver must complete a 240 km trip in 4 hours. He averages 70 km/h for the first 3 hours of his trip.

**Concept:**

To find the required speed for the last hour, we need to determine the remaining distance and then calculate the speed needed to cover that distance in the remaining time.

**Calculation:**

Total distance to be covered = 240 km

Total time available = 4 hours

Distance covered in the first 3 hours:

⇒ Distance = Speed × Time

⇒ Distance = 70 km/h × 3 hours

⇒ Distance = 210 km

Remaining distance to be covered in the final hour:

⇒ Remaining distance = Total distance - Distance covered in the first 3 hours

⇒ Remaining distance = 240 km - 210 km

⇒ Remaining distance = 30 km

Speed required to cover the remaining distance in the final hour:

⇒ Speed = Distance / Time

⇒ Speed = 30 km / 1 hour

⇒ Speed = 30 km/h

**∴ The bus driver must travel at 30 km/h in the last hour.**

questions.question: If a circle whose centre is (2, 3) touches the line 4x + 3y - 7 = 0, then the radius of the circle is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Center of the circle = (2, 3)

Equation of the line = 4x + 3y - 7 = 0

**Formula used:**

Distance from a point (x₁, y₁) to a line ax + by + c = 0 is:

Distance = |a x₁ + b y₁ + c| / √(a² + b²)

**Calculations:**

Substitute (x₁, y₁) = (2, 3) and the line equation 4x + 3y - 7 = 0 into the formula:

Distance = |(4 × 2) + (3 × 3) - 7| / √(4² + 3²)

⇒ Distance = |8 + 9 - 7| / √(16 + 9)

⇒ Distance = |10| / √25

⇒ Distance = 10 / 5

⇒ Distance = 2

**∴ The radius of the circle is 2 units.**

questions.question: Among the ratios 3 : 4, 5 : 8, 1 : 2, 6 : 9 which is the greatest?
questions.solution:

5/8 = 0.625

Compare the decimal values:

0.75 > 0.625 > 0.6667 > 0.5

**The greatest ratio is 3 : 4.**
